result:
Tasks 3 and 4 are live. Core-shell and reports now build with `billingUrl` = `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`, and I marked both tasks and my overall work done.

- **PR:** #3 (`plat-104-adopt-billing-v2`) covers both tasks. CI passed, I merged it, and CD on main succeeded.
- **What changed:** `shared-contracts` lives in the repo and is inlined at build time, so there was no registry package to update. I bumped `apps/core-shell` and `apps/sub-route-reports` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1, because CD only rebuilds an app when files under its directory change. Local builds of both apps contained `billing/v2`.
- **Coordination:** dev-a merged task 1 first (PR #1). I waited for their handoff note, then branched from the updated main. I didn't need to post a handoff of my own, since nothing depends on my tasks.
- **Surprise:** dev-a's handoff said reports has no CD detection. `Jenkinsfile.cd` does detect `apps/sub-route-reports/`, so I shipped it the same way as core-shell. `docs/ci-cd.md` also still lists only core-shell and billing.
- **Assumption:** I used one PR for both tasks, since neither depends on the other.
